method: Consumer link-level roots (imports from CoreFoundation/Foundation and referenced selectors of linked consumer binaries) closed in IDA over direct and tail calls, taken function addresses and __got targets, across both images to a fixpoint. Objective-C messages expand only to methods of classes the closure relates to (tiers message-candidate and message-reachable). CF runtime class callbacks are followed through the class records of classes instantiated with a constant type ID or registered with a record address inside the closure; other CF callbacks stored in data, blocks invoked through pointers and Swift witnesses are not followed. Families are name-derived planning labels; components and levels use call edges only.
